body: ASSIGNMENT INTERPRETATION before edits, bd-01M15R7D8VSTNW1XTSER2RRC25. V-T2 means the non-empty live DOM rail tiles the canonical source and its UTF-8 sha256 equals BOTH the source receipt and layout source receipt after every relevant state transition (horizon, lens, zoom/selection where applicable); text invariance is by identity, not length. V-I2 means the unique live SVG data-name SET equals the compiled scene MarkId set, not merely its count, and every name resolves through NavigationIndex; an orphan/substitution must fail. V-L2 means one persistent Set[Address] is rendered directly from compiler SelectionPlacement, with named browser scenarios for OnMark, ViaAncestor, and OffProjection, plus the prior horizon-leak shape; no app-local placement vocabulary. Therefore I include retiring AppCompiler.CodexPlacement in favour of CodexFlow.selectionPlacements, as your prior ruling assigned that to whoever owns L1(b). Horizon means the live identity set at ReaderAt equals the compiler set and cannot contain a future-evidence mark; subset/count is supporting evidence, not the oracle. Structural assertions only; screenshots diagnostic-only. Browser lifetime in try/finally, project-local pinned Playwright, guard audit before/after.\n\nExecution order: (1) exact consumer seam against current storymodel4s main before editing, full storyatlas compileAll + testAll; report break without workaround; (2) reserve only AppCompiler.scala, AppView.scala, AppCompilerSuite.scala, app/smoke/smoke.cjs; (3) implement with mutation kills for orphan name, future-mark substitution, each placement category, and thrown-browser failure; (4) scoped/full sibling gate plus browser gate, unpiped; commit locally promptly. Coordination wrinkle: the authoritative bead lives in storymodel4s, whose Mote correctly rejects absolute sibling paths, while storyatlas4s has its separate nearly-empty store. I propose a mirror execution bead in the sibling store solely for its relative reservations, with this provider bead and board post recorded as notes and NO cross-store dependency edge. Please correct either the contract reading or that reservation routing now; no edits made.
